name: Live casino
checks: Studio breadth, seat limits at the table, stream latency, and which provider is behind the glass.
measured: Latency timed from a funded seat

name: Slots
checks: The RTP build each operator actually ships, volatility, max-win ceiling and how the mechanic pays.
measured: Paytables read in every operator build

name: Game providers
checks: Whether the studio permits reduced RTP configurations, its volatility range, and catalogue reach.

name: Sportsbooks
checks: Margin priced across 40 matched selections, market depth outside majors, settlement speed.

name: Prediction markets
checks: Cost to trade, book depth, resolution source, and what the payout rail actually requires.

name: Wallets
checks: Custody model, chain coverage, what it shows you before you sign, and fee handling.

name: Exchanges
checks: Spread sampled hourly, fiat rails, withdrawal limits and the combined cost of getting on chain.

name: Fiat casinos
checks: Licence, deposit rails, payout in days, wagering. Kept on a separate list, never mixed into the crypto ranking.
